name: agiprolabs/claude-trading-skills
description: A trading collection of 68 skills including risk management, backtesting with backtrader, copy trading, dex execution, kelly criterion, and portfolio analytics. The verified sample is a risk management skill. Install is via the plugin route or clone plus copy.
install: /plugin marketplace add agiprolabs/claude-trading-skills then /plugin install trading-skills@agiprolabs-claude-trading-skills, plus git clone plus copy. Plugin route only for the draft; the README prerequisite of a uv install via a pipe for uv itself is not drafted.
